title: Sign-in UI for the deployed app (Cognito email, allow-listed)
description: The deployed app has no sign-in screen (web/src/data/auth.ts has the functions; nothing in web/src/ui calls them). Library, Score and every record are readable only by signed-in group members (userPools), so without sign-in the cloud Library/Score tabs cannot show anything. Build the flow: sign up / confirm code / sign in / sign out with Cognito email (Google later, see ff09d9), postConfirmation adds the user to a group, only APRICITY_ALLOWED_EMAILS may sign up. Visual/UX belongs to the web session: coordinate here. Verify by the owner signing up at https://apricity.anth.us (agents must not create accounts or enter passwords).
